verdict.rationale: Zep exposes a broad programmatic surface: a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec with 148 paths and about 150 SDK reference endpoints. Its zepctl CLI is described as providing "full access to Zep" for users, threads, Context Graphs and data operations. However, no evidence explicitly states API/UI parity, and dashboard-specific functions (RBAC for dashboard users, dashboard audit logs) are not shown to be API-reachable. missing for 10: explicit documented API-to-dashboard parity, evidence that admin/governance functions (dashboard RBAC, audit logs) are available via API, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: help.getzep.com serves a full OpenAPI 3.1 document (info title "SDK Reference", 148 paths, servers https://api.getzep.com/api/v4)
It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.
The Fern-rendered SDK Reference pages (about 150 endpoints under help.getzep.com/v4/sdk-reference) each carry a "Try it" in-page API explorer
